newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Furman Selz starts managed care cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Furman Selz starts managed care cos.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said it initiated coverage of United Healthcare Corp with a neutral rating. Said United Healthcare is bellwether of HMO group and set a 1997 earnings estimate at $2.35 a share.
-- Initiated coverage of Oxford Health Plans Inc as neutral. Oxford gained 1-9/16 to 55.
-- Initiated coverage of PacifiCare Health Systems Inc as a strong buy and added the stock to its recommended list. Set a 12-month target in low $120s. PacifiCare gained 3/4 to 74-3/8.
-- Initiated coverage of Humana Inc with a neutral rating. Expects Humana to earn $1.05 a share in 1997. Humana closed Wednesday at 18.
-- Initiated coverage of Foundation Health Corp with a neutral rating. Expects Foundation to earn $2.62 a share in 1997. Foundation gained 1/2 to 30-7/8.
